summary: The v0.5.14 implementation reproduces the reported 614406-vs-614408 page-table mismatch by construction. Current main already sizes the DSA CUDA-graph page table and replay copy from req_to_token.shape[1]; a new GPU regression verifies the reported dimensions and independent boundaries. No additional production fix was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Historical v0.5.14 allocation and EAGLE source widths reproduce the exact RuntimeError reported in the issue on the assigned GPU.
Current allocator/helper/copy path at 614408 columns, exact GPU tensor equality, and three independent page-table width boundaries; 2 tests and 3 subtests passed.
Repository formatting, lint, and registered-test metadata checks passed.

gpu_evidence: Tests ran with HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 on one AMD Instinct MI350X, gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, using torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.
remaining_limitations: No ZhipuAI/GLM-5.2-FP8 weights were available, so model architecture behavior and semantic accuracy were not tested.
Only one gfx950 ROCm GPU was assigned; the reported TP=8 Blackwell CUDA deployment and multi-worker process failure were not reproduced.
The focused test validates allocation and replay-copy shape invariants on GPU but does not execute a CUDA graph on NVIDIA hardware.
The source issue remains open, so this result is candidate verification of the existing fix rather than an upstream closure claim.
